scores.notes: Alice centre-left looks across at a wide-eyed Hatter holding cup and bread, March Hare beside him, tea-table under a big tree before a brick house; the Dormouse sits upright in a chair rather than dozing on the table, a minor deviation. No lettering, fully painted edges.

Four winged creatures (man, lion, ox, eagle) with eyes on their wings flank an empty throne under a rainbow on a glassy floor; no figure is drawn on the throne. No lettering or frame; creatures are dignified rather than fearsome but not comic.

Disciples in a boat at the shore with Peter stepping onto the beach toward a coal fire with fish and loaves; misty lake and stone village behind. Peter holds two staffs, odd but not malformed; no lettering.
Watercolour of two mud-brick cities burning under streaks of falling fire, smoke columns and orange sky, small fleeing figures in wraps along the edges. Edges are painted to the border; no lettering.

Indignant Alice in an armchair at the table end points at the March Hare, who holds a teapot with an elbow on the dozing Dormouse beside the Hatter, under a tree before a house. No lettering; corners painted.
Disciples bail and row a wave-swept boat at night with a swinging lamp, other boats nearby and Jesus asleep on a cushion in the stern. No lettering; hands and faces read correctly.

Holmes kneels with lantern and lens while Merryweather sulks on a crate in a vaulted cellar, but a second magnifying lens lies on the flagstones beside the one in Holmes's hand (lower centre), a duplicated prop. No lettering.

Young David strides by a streambed with staff, dangling sling and bag; armoured Goliath with spear and shield stands mid-valley with soldiers on the slopes. Goliath does not read as towering and no shield-bearer is shown, minor; no lettering.
Rays of golden light break through dark clouds over a dark sea; no figure, face or shape is formed in the light. No lettering; edges painted.

Hatter with teacup and bread before the bench, King and spectacled Queen above, Hare and Dormouse at left, animal jury with slates; the King's card tabard carries a 'K' index and scattered papers and slates bear scribbled pseudo-writing.

Image is a split diptych with a hard vertical seam at about one-third width: Peter stands alone in the left panel, the brazier and bystanders in the right; Jesus is not identifiable and no meeting of gazes is shown.
Peter in the foreground looks across the courtyard toward a white-robed Jesus by the brazier with bystanders, guards by the gate behind. No lettering; edges painted.
The Levite stands over a cloaked body with a knife held low, lamp on a bench, donkey and bundles through the moonlit doorway; no cutting or gore shown. No lettering.

Moses gestures toward a foraging pig at left with Aaron in breastplate beside him, tents, families and the tabernacle court behind. The cloud-and-fire radiance is absent, minor; God is not drawn; breastplate stones carry no glyphs.

Alice leans forward indignantly at the table end; Dormouse dozes with a cup beside the March Hare and Hatter at the far end under a big tree before a house. Elbows-on-Dormouse is not shown, minor; no lettering.
Daniel raises a hand before the enthroned Belshazzar in a glazed-brick hall, but a glowing hand writes a clear line of glyph-like script on the back wall (centre).
Holmes reaches up after tossing a rolled bundle of newspapers onto the rack while Watson, hat on knee, watches; the newspapers show columns of printed pseudo-text (upper right).

Playing-card courtiers carry 'A' and 'K' corner indices (left); Alice is drawn child-sized beside the cards though she has grown huge in this moment, and the black-haired Queen's tall heart-lined collar follows the animated-film costume.
Alice leans toward the Dormouse sitting on the table with a cup, March Hare pouring and Hatter with cup and bread across the table under a large tree. Tablecloth marks are stains, not letters.
Jesus stands alone with arm extended in a separate small boat roped to the disciples' boat instead of in the stern of their boat; disciples grip the rail on calming water.
Peter with net and staff and two disciples step up from a beached boat toward a coal fire with fish and bread; misty shore, village and net racks behind. No lettering.
Holmes, Watson, a bandaged Hatherley and Bradstreet lean from the carriage as the station-master points to a smoke column, but Holmes's face (upper left) closely resembles Benedict Cumberbatch.
The father strides toward his son with arms wide on a village road, the son pausing with hand raised, villagers in a doorway at left. No lettering.

Soldiers crouch casting lots over garments with the crucified figure distant; the titulus plaque on the cross carries faint pseudo-inscription marks, and the Jerusalem skyline shows an anachronistic blue dome resembling the Dome of the Rock (left).
Darius kneels at the pit rim reaching down to Daniel standing unharmed among calm lions, two attendants with rope and lamp behind. No lettering.
Jesus stands in the boat with arm extended over calm water while the disciples huddle and grip the rail, shore faint behind. No lettering.
